title: Reading routes
html:
A few minutes

Summary → latest results → open questions.

Technical review

Methods → detailed overview → relevant topic → series INDEX → FINAL_REPORT/RESULTS → protocol and mathematical analysis → correction log.

Independent reviewer or Codex

Start with the reviewer guide. Distinguish exhaustive searches, limited samples, incomplete SAT attempts, and synthetic successes. Do not execute historical plans as current instructions.

For chronology, use the main journal and index. A later clarification takes precedence only for the same model and problem formulation. It does not retroactively rewrite the original report.
